notes: Safety Tracker v2.10.88 CLEAN. Re-analyse now performs full existing-source analysis for both asbestos Management Surveys and AMPs. Surveys re-extract metadata, all structured ACM findings, pages and the full location catalogue, then compare against the live register as unchanged/changed/new/missing. AMPs extract document control fields, responsibilities, source survey, objectives, work controls, monitoring, emergency procedure, review/closure, location hierarchy and register-reference cross-check. Re-analysis approval reconciles existing ACMs without creating duplicates or pretending a physical reinspection occurred.
